title: Partnership year-end review: 2025 practice metrics
audience: law firm partnership meeting, year-end review
core_points: Firm-wide billable hours: 142,307 (up 4.3% YoY), realization held at 94.1%
Practice-area mix: M&A 28%, litigation 24%, IP 17%, regulatory 12%, tax 11%, other 8%
Originations gap: rainmaking is concentrated in 7 partners generating 61% of new business
Lateral recruiting: 9 laterals joined, 2 departed; retention of first-year laterals at 88%
Diversity metrics: partner pipeline 38% women, 22% historically underrepresented, both up
Associate attrition: 14.2% (vs 18% market), mid-level attrition remains highest-risk cohort
Technology investment: document automation rollout saved 9,400 hours across litigation practice
Risk events: 2 malpractice claims filed, both resolved without payout, policy renewal flat
Client concentration: top 10 clients = 32% of revenue (target: below 35%), broadly healthy
Strategic initiatives for 2026: originations coaching, junior partner track, APAC expansion study
Partnership votes needed today: new equity admits, comp committee recommendations, APAC go/no-go
